title: The border with Haiti: a shared island
goal: Report facts about the border with Haiti and say who gives each explanation (*según*, *informó de que*, *explica que*).
grammar: reporting information and citing sources, applied to the Dominican–Haitian border

items: I can say who reports or judges something with *según* and *explica que*.
I can give the dates of 1844, 1937 and 2013 and say who disagrees about what.
I can use the new words for sugar-cane workers, the harvest and a court ruling.
